howto.name: Upload an image
howto.text: JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Select OCR language
howto.text: 17 Tesseract languages available: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Arabic, Hindi, Vietnamese.

howto.name: Download as text or JSON
howto.text: Plain text: all detected text. JSON: text + per-word bounding boxes for layout-aware processing.

faq.a: Tesseract handles clean printed text very well (98%+). Handwriting, low-resolution, or low-contrast images are harder.

faq.q: Should I preprocess the image first?
faq.a: Deskew helps a lot for tilted scans. Convert to grayscale doesn't help (Tesseract converts internally).
Tesseract is trained on print. Use a specialized handwriting OCR for cursive.
